name: systeme.io
verdict: No developer app registration or OAuth was found. Each customer creates a Public API key in Settings and pastes it in, likely 1-3 days; details are largely unverified (low confidence).
needGuide: No — just collect each customer's Public API key (Settings → Public API keys).

auth.detail: Public API authenticated with a per-account API key (generally sent in an X-API-Key header, from general knowledge, unverified here). No OAuth app model was found. The developer docs at developer.systeme.io could not be fetched (blocked by robots rules), so details are unconfirmed.

approval.gate: None known. There is no developer app registration, review, or partner approval documented; each customer creates a key and pastes it into your app. If you want OAuth or a native integration, ask systeme.io support or partnerships (no program found).

scopes.why: No scopes known; a key presumably grants account-wide access.
scopes.summary: No scopes known: an API key presumably grants account-wide access to contacts, tags and similar resources. Ask customers to use a dedicated key so it can be revoked independently.

cost: Free to build; API access may depend on the customer's plan (not confirmed)
prerequisites: Account and owner: Any developer with a systeme.io account on which to create a test key; use a company-owned test account.
Where you register: Customer logs in -> Settings -> Public API keys (exact menu name unverified; the site footer links a 'Public API' help article)
Cost: Free to build; API access may depend on the customer's plan (not confirmed)

registerAt.path: Customer logs in -> Settings -> Public API keys (exact menu name unverified; the site footer links a 'Public API' help article)

steps.do: Customer opens systeme.io -> Settings -> Public API keys, creates a key, and copies it
Build a connect screen where the customer pastes the key; store it encrypted and never log it
Validate immediately with a cheap read call (list contacts, limit 1) sending the key header; show a clear error on 401
Document in-app how to create and revoke the key and which plan is required
Check the Public API docs for webhooks or polling, then choose sync method; rate-limit client calls
Email systeme.io support to ask whether an OAuth or partner integration is planned

roles.team: Any developer with a systeme.io account on which to create a test key; use a company-owned test account.
roles.customer: The account owner (or a user permitted to see Settings) creates the API key and pastes it into your app; revoking the key cuts access.

testing: Create your own systeme.io account (free plan likely) and a test key; run read calls (for example list contacts) and write calls on dummy contacts.

blockers.problem: A shared key gives full account access
blockers.fix: Store encrypted and offer easy key rotation.

blockers.problem: API availability by plan is unconfirmed
blockers.fix: Tell customers which plan is required once verified.

automation.humanMust: Customer creates and pastes the key; a human contacts systeme.io about OAuth or a partner path.
